correctness.rationale: A uniform face-by-face analysis gives the dual complex of dimensions 0 through 3, with \(6n\) elementary collapse pairs and integral \(H_1\) rank \(B_n\). The equivariant Alexander duality carries the ambient permutation sign; exact signed chain fixed-point traces for rotations and reflections yield the stated full character and average. One independent standard-library verifier reconstructs all 1,200 collapses for \(5\le n\le20\), validates 800 dihedral traces, and checks 72 directly computed ordinary-cut-complex Lefschetz numbers for \(5\le n\le7\). These checks supplement an explicit all-n proof. Restrictions: \(n\ge5\), natural \(D_{2n}\), rational characters.

originality.rationale: Against primary papers, public related results and previously established scientific results, no checked mathematical statement determines the full \(D_{2n}\) character of ordinary Möbius three-cut homology. value.rationale: The entire natural dihedral character of a canonical infinite family upgrades previously known nonequivariant sphere counts to explicit symmetry actions, two reflection parity types, and exact invariant/quotient rational Betti rank \(\lfloor(n-3)/2\rfloor\). These natural representation invariants cannot be deduced from the wedge multiplicity alone and distinguish the Möbius twist from the analogous circular-ladder family. No arbitrary parameter cut or unsupported downstream theorem is required.
